digest.component_or_area: git-fetch test suite and stall-remote fixture
propositions: Full suite intermittently misclassifies valid dribbling git-fetch traffic as stalled due to scheduler-delayed Python fixture wake-ups reducing cumulative throughput below the low-speed rate limit.
Tests share a 2-second artificial low-speed window between zero-byte stall controls and above-floor negative controls, causing production-valid traffic to trip under scheduler load.
Cumulative bytes-owed catch-up calculation alone is insufficient because libcurl aborts before recovery can occur during uninterrupted scheduling gaps.
The stable fix segregates fast 2-second zero-byte stall tests from one production 10-second window real Git/libcurl dribble integration test and makes pacing math deterministic via unit test.
